_comment: Powers studentlife.html. `milestones` use {left,title,meta,details} like cv.json, plus optional `image` (single) or `images` (array of paths) pointing at assets/img/studentlife/*.jpg. All photos are resized and carry a tiled anti-theft watermark.
intro: Seven years, 2019 to 2026 — from the first day of university to my master's graduation. This is the unofficial record: the moments that never made it onto a CV, told in chronological order. (Photos are watermarked to keep them mine.)

milestones.title: University begins
details: I thought I'd finally escaped the endless classes and exams everyone promised would end once I got to college. And of course, the very first lesson was military training!

milestones.title: Elected class secretary
details: As an introvert, I decided to push myself and run for class secretary. And I actually won! 😀

milestones.title: First chemistry labs
details: Started doing chemistry labs. Organic synthesis got pretty boring later on, but the copper sulfate crystals and orange-essential-oil extraction are moments I'll never forget.

milestones.title: Marathon club
details: Joined the marathon club — I even planned to run a half marathon! It never happened, derailed by the pandemic and the rush of graduation. I also became the club's vice president 😀. I've started training again lately, so maybe I'll actually run that half marathon one day.

milestones.title: Online classes, pandemic era
details: Started the semester under the pandemic — online classes are something only Chinese students can truly relate to.

milestones.title: First taste of research
details: Joined Professor Xue's lab and got my first real taste of research!

milestones.title: Bachelor's graduation
details: Graduated with my bachelor's! The on-and-off pandemic and research had settled my life back into something calm.

milestones.title: Master's begins
details: Started my master's. To qualify for a company internship in year two, I worked hard and finished my first project during year one — while still taking classes.

milestones.title: Beijing · CR Double-Crane internship
details: Off to Beijing! I joined CR Double-Crane for a joint training program — my first time living far from home. There I learned mouse dosing and dissection, cell culture, and basic cell-based experiments.

milestones.title: Work-life balance
details: After joining the company, I briefly lived the work-life balance I'd always wanted — my own time after work, weekend trips, and city breaks on long weekends.

milestones.title: A new research project
details: Started a new graduate project and a busy life: lab work by day, computation by night.

milestones.title: Master's graduation (valedictorian speech)
details: Graduated with my master's! I even gave the graduation speech as a student representative and was named an Outstanding Graduate of Chongqing — the moment my meritocratic streak finally paid off.

milestones.title: Reflections
details: Right now I'm searching for the meaning of life. I used to think I'd lived a painful existence, but sorting through all this I realized how rich my life has been — joy and happiness, struggle and grit, even moments of breaking down, all now part of who I am. I don't know if anyone will ever read this, but looking back has already made me treasure and affirm my own effort.
